Daily Quiz.question: ১) Identify the correct interrogative form of the sentence below : 'We bleed if you prick us.'
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) If you prick us, do we bleed?
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Do you bleed if you prick us?
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) If you prick us, do we not bleed?
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) If you do not prick us, do we bleed?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Assertive বাক্য যদি হ্যাঁ-বোধক হয় তাহলে অধিকাংশ ক্ষেত্রেই তাকে interrogative করতে হলে তাকে একি সাথে negative -interrogative করতে হয়।
আমরা এই বাক্যটির Principal clause-কে negative-interrogative-এ পরিণত করেছি।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

Daily Quiz.question: ২) The correct Assertive form of ''How swiftly the cat runs!'' is-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The cat runs swiftly.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) How swiftly the cat runs.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The cat runs how swiftly.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The cat runs very swiftly.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Exclamatory Sentence-এ যদি adjective/adverb-এর আগে how/what থাকে তাহলে very/great বসাতে হয়।
এক্ষেত্রে how + Adv. + NP + Verb থেকে আমরা NP + verb + adverb structure-এ পরিণত হয়েছে।
Source: A Passage to the English Language by S. M. Zakir Hussain

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Select the right positive structure of the sentence : ''He is more cunning than a fox.''
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He is as cunning as a fox.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) A fox is as cunning as he is.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) A fox is less cunning than he.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) A fox is not so cunning as he.
Daily Quiz.exp:
than-যুক্ত comparative degree-কে positive degree-তে রূপান্তরের সময় নিচের নিয়মটি প্রয়োগ করতে হয়ঃ
i) প্রদত্ত sentence-এর than-এর পরের অংশ প্রথমে বসে। ii) Verb বসে + iii) মূল sentenceটি affirmative হলে not বসে; কিন্তু মূল sentence negative হলে not উঠে যায়। + iv) so বসে + v) Comparative degree-এর Positive form বসে। + vi) as + vii) প্রদত্ত sentence-এর প্রথম subject বসে।
Source: Chowdhury and Hussain

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Identify the right assertive form of ''Who could ever count my love for you?''
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Who would never count my love for you.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Nobody could ever count my love for you.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Everybody could ever count my love for you.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Anybody could ever count my love for you.
Daily Quiz.exp: Who যুক্ত interrogative Sentence-কে Assertive Sentence করতে হলে who-এর পরিবর্তে nobody + বাক্যের বাকি অংশ বসে এবং Question mark-এর পরিবর্তে full-stop বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Identify the right interrogative form of the sentence: 'It does not matter if we lose the game.'
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) What though if we lose the game?
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Why does it matter if we lose the game?
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Does it not matter if we lose game?
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Does it matter if do we lose the game?
Daily Quiz.exp: It does not matter-এর পরিবর্তে what though + পরের অংশ + প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Identify the correct Simple form of this sentence: "Though the man has much riches, he wants more."
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The man has much riches and he wants more
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Despite of his having much riches, he wants more.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Even though the man he has much riches, he wants more.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The man has much riches, but he wants more.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Though/Although-এর পরিবর্তে despite/in spite of বসে + উক্ত clause-এর subject he-এর possessive form his বসেছে+ প্রদত্ত sentence-এর বাকি অংশ বসেছে।

প্রশ্নের অপশনে সঠিক উত্তর নেই। ব্যাখ্যা ঠিক আছে।
অপশন খ) Despite of এর বদলে Despite বা In spite of থাকলে সেটি সঠিক উত্তর হতো।

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) The correct simple form of “Read attentively or you cannot pass the examination” is -
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Without reading attentively, you cannot pass the examination.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) If you do not read attentively, you cannot pass the examination.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) You do not read attentively and you cannot pass the examination.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Because you do not read attentively, you cannot pass the examination.
Daily Quiz.exp: Or যুক্ত compound sentence কে সিম্পল করতে গেলে প্রথমে without বসে + প্রথম বাক্যের মূল verb-এর সাথে ing যোগ করতে হয় + ক্রিয়ার পরের অংশ বসে+ or এর পরিবর্তে comma বসে + দ্বিতীয় বাক্য বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Which one is a simple sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) It was twenty years ago, and I was living in Paris.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Twenty years ago, I was living in Paris.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) When it was twenty years ago, I was living in Paris.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Twenty years passed since I lived in Paris.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Simple Sentence হল এমন একটি বাক্য যেখানে শুধু একটি মাত্র clause থাকে এবং একটিমাত্র subject ও predicate থাকে।
অপশন B-তে শুধু একটি clause আছে, I হল এর একটিমাত্র Subject এবং was living in a paris হল Predicate.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Which one is a complex sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I know him to be honest.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I know that he is honest.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He is honest and I know it.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He is honest yet I know it.
Daily Quiz.exp:
A complex sentence is a sentence with one independent clause and at least one dependent clause.
It works best when you need to provide more information to explain or modify your sentence's main point.
আমরা দেখতে পাচ্ছি যে, অপশন B-তে I know একটি Independent Clause এবং that he is honest একটি Dependent clause। তাই, এটি Complex Sentence।

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Identify the correct positive form for this sentence: "Iron is one of the most useful metals."
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Very few metals are so useful as iron.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) No other metals are as useful as iron.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Iron is not the most useful metal.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) It is true that Iron is one of the most useful metals.
Daily Quiz.exp:
One of the যুক্ত Superlative degree -কে positive degree-তে রূপান্তর করতে হলে নিয়মটি হলঃ
প্রথমে very few বসে + Superlative degree-এর পরের অংশ + verb-এর plural form + so + superlative degree-এর positive form + as প্রদত্ত sentence-এর Subject

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Identify the correct comparative form of this sentence: "Saudi Arabia is one of the hottest countries in the world."
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Saudi Arabia is hotter than other country in the world.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Saudi Arabia is hotter than most other countries in the world.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Saudi Arabia is not so hot as other countries in the world.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Saudi Arabia is very hot country.
Daily Quiz.exp:
One of the যুক্ত Superlative degree -কে comparative degree-তে রূপান্তর করতে হলে নিয়মটি হলঃ
প্রদত্ত sentence-এর subject ও verb বসে + one of the উঠে যায় + Superlative degree-এর comparative form বসে + than most other বসে + প্রদত্ত sentence-এর বাকি অংশ বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Identify the correct passive form: "I saw him reading a book."
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I was seen reading a book by him.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I saw him who was reading a book.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I saw him and he was reading a book.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He was seen reading a book by me.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Subject + Verb+ Object + Present participle যুক্ত Active Voice-কে passive Voice-এ পরিণত করতে হলে নিয়মটি হলঃ
objectটি Subject হয় + Tense ও Person অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb বসে। + মূল verb-এর past participle বসে + present participle যুক্ত অংশটি বসে + by বসে + Subjectটির objective form বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Panic seized the writer. (Make it passive)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The writer was seized by panic.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The writer was seized with panic.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The writer was seized on panic.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Panic was seized in the writer.
Daily Quiz.exp: অনেক ক্ষেত্রে Active থেকে passive করতে গেলে by ছাড়াও অন্যান্য preposition ব্যবহার করা হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) One should take care of one’s health. (Make it passive)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) One should be taken care of one’s health.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) One’s health should be taken care by one.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) One’s health is taken care of.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Health should be taken care of.
Daily Quiz.exp: One+should যুক্ত বাক্য কে passive করার নিয়মঃ প্রথমে objectটি Subject হয় + should be + মূল verb-এর past participle বসে

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) I saw him go. (Make it passive)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Going by him was seen by me.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He was seen to go by me.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He was seen going by me.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He was seen go by me.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Need, see, bid, dare, make, hear, feel, let, know, behold, watch প্রভৃতি verb গুলোর পর Active Voice-এ to উহ্য থাকে।
তবে passive করার সময় তাদের পরে to বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) His behavior surprised me. (Make it passive)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I was surprised at his behavior.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I was surprised with his behavior.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I was surprised by his behavior.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I was surprised for his behavior.
Daily Quiz.exp:
অনেক ক্ষেত্রে Active থেকে passive করতে গেলে by ছাড়াও অন্যান্য preposition ব্যবহার করা হয়।
এখানে সঠিক preposition হবে at.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) People say that the lion is the king of beast. (Make it passive)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) It is said that the lion is the king of beast.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) That is said by the people is the king of the beast.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The beast is being the king by the people.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) That the lion is the king of the beast is by the people.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Compound Sentence এবং Complex Sentence-এর ক্ষেত্রে Active voice-এর উভয় clause-কে একই voice-এ রূপান্তর করতে হয়।
Active Voice People say দিয়ে শুরু হলে passive voice It is said দিয়ে শুরু করা হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Identify the correct active form of the sentence: "English is spoken all over the world."
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The world speaking English.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) All over the world is being spoken in English.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The world is speaking in English.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) People speak English all over the world.
Daily Quiz.exp: Passive Voice-এ অনেক সময় object উহ্য থাকে। সেক্ষেত্রে Active-এ রূপান্তর করতে গেলে যথাযথ Subject বসাতে হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Which one is a compound sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Work hard, without it you can not prosper in life.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Work hard to prosper in life.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Without working hard, you will not prosper in life.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Work hard or you will not prosper in life..
Daily Quiz.exp:
A compound sentence is a sentence that connects two independent clauses, typically with a coordinating conjunction like and or but.
They’re best for combining two or more self-sufficient and related sentences into a single, unified one.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) He decided to sell the house. (Passive)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He decided the housed to be sold.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He decided and the housed is sold.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He decided that the house should be sold.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The house is sold by his decision.
Daily Quiz.exp: Agree/be anxious/arrange/determine/be determined/decide/demand+infinitve + object যুক্ত Active Voice-কে passive Voice-e রূপান্তরিত করার নিয়মঃ প্রদত্ত Active Voice-এর subject ও verb বসে। + that বসে + infinitve-এর পরের object বসে। + should be + infinitive-এর পরের verb-এর past Participle বসে।
